``` {r adding in missing metadata}
add_image_metadata <- function(data, filename_col = file_name_original) {
  data %>%
    extract(
      {{ filename_col }},
      into = c("strain", "treatment", "date", "image_number"),
      regex = "^([^_]+)_([^_]+)_([0-9]+_[0-9]+_[0-9]+).*?_([0-9]+)_MIP\\.tif$",
      remove = FALSE
    ) %>%
    mutate(image_number = as.integer(image_number))
}

tibble_names <- c("data_012026", "data_022026", "data_01262026", 
                  "data_01282026", "data_01302026", "data_02022026", 
                  "data_02032026", "data_02042026", "data_02052026", 
                  "data_02062026", "data_02072026")

for (nm in tibble_names) {
  assign(nm, add_image_metadata(get(nm)))
}

```

``` {r grouping by experiment and full data}
expt_1 <- bind_rows(data_01262026, data_01282026, data_01302026, data_012026) %>%
  mutate(expt_number = 1) %>%
  mutate(
    day = case_when(
      date == "1_26_2026" ~ 1,
      date == "1_28_2026" ~ 3,
      date == "1_30_2026" ~ 5,
      date == "1_30_26" ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(file_name_original, strain, treatment, date, image_number, expt_number, day, everything())

expt_2_redos <- data_022026 %>%
  filter(date %in% c("2_2_26", "2_4_26", "2_6_26"))

expt_2 <- bind_rows(data_02022026, data_02042026, data_02062026, expt_2_redos) %>%
  mutate(expt_number = 2) %>%
  mutate(
    day = case_when(
      date == "2_2_26" ~ 1,
      date == "2_4_26" ~ 3,
      date == "2_6_26" ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(file_name_original, strain, treatment, date, image_number, expt_number, day, everything())

expt_3_redos <- data_022026 %>%
  filter(date %in% c("2_3_26", "2_5_26", "2_7_26"))

expt_3 <- bind_rows(data_02032026, data_02052026, data_02072026, expt_3_redos) %>%
  mutate(expt_number = 3) %>%
  mutate(
    day = case_when(
      date == "2_3_26" ~ 1,
      date == "2_5_26" ~ 3,
      date == "2_7_26" ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(file_name_original, strain, treatment, date, image_number, expt_number, day, everything())

all_data <- bind_rows(expt_1, expt_2, expt_3)
```

#General Plots - Raw Data
``` {r full dataset plot and histogram}
ggplot(all_data, aes(x = factor(day), y = area_shape_area)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid(strain ~ treatment) +
  xlab("Day") +
  ylab("Neuron Area (pixels)") +
  theme_bw()

hist(all_data$area_shape_area)
```

#Normalization
``` {r normalizing the data}
#Here, I'm normalizing within expt and within strain to the strain control (ctrl or solv) depending on the treatment

all_data_norm <- all_data %>%
  group_by(strain, expt_number, day) %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate reference mean for area
    ref_mean_area = case_when(
      treatment %in% c("ctrl", "tca")   ~ mean(area_shape_area[treatment == "ctrl"], na.rm = TRUE),
      treatment %in% c("solv", "tceoh") ~ mean(area_shape_area[treatment == "solv"], na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    # Normalize area to percent of reference
    area_percent = (area_shape_area / ref_mean_area) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

``` {r raw plots + distribution plots}
ggplot(all_data_norm, aes(x = factor(day), y = area_percent)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid(strain ~ treatment) +
  xlab("Day") +
  ylab("Percent Control of Neuron Area") +
  theme_bw()

hist(all_data_norm$area_percent)
``` 

#Subseting and General Info
``` {r subset datasets + edit}
#Prepping the data for ANOVA and also for better plotting
all_data_norm <- all_data_norm %>%
  mutate(
    Dose = case_when(
      treatment == "ctrl"  ~ "Vehicle Control",
      treatment == "tca"   ~ "10 mM TCA",
      treatment == "solv"  ~ "Solvent Control",
      treatment == "tceoh" ~ "5 mM TCEOH",
      TRUE ~ treatment
    )) %>%
  mutate(Strain = case_when(
    strain == "bz555" ~ "BZ555",
    strain == "ua44" ~ "UA44",
    TRUE ~ strain
  )) %>%
  rename(Day = day)

#Subseting the data - TCA
tca_data_norm <- all_data_norm %>%
  filter(Dose %in% c("Vehicle Control", "10 mM TCA")) %>%
  mutate(
    Dose = factor(Dose, levels = c("Vehicle Control", "10 mM TCA"))
  )

tca_data_norm_bz555 <- tca_data_norm %>%
  filter(Strain == "BZ555")

tca_data_norm_ua44 <- tca_data_norm %>%
  filter(Strain == "UA44")

#Subsetting the data - TCEOH
tceoh_data_norm <- all_data_norm %>%
  filter(Dose %in% c("Solvent Control", "5 mM TCEOH")) %>%
  mutate(
    Dose = factor(Dose, levels = c("Solvent Control", "5 mM TCEOH"))
  )

tceoh_data_norm_bz555 <- tceoh_data_norm %>%
  filter(Strain == "BZ555")

tceoh_data_norm_ua44 <- tceoh_data_norm %>%
  filter(Strain == "UA44")
```

``` {r information on n per group}
n_per_group_tca <- tca_data_norm %>%
  group_by(Strain, Dose, Day) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),                          # total neurons measured
    n_worms = n_distinct(image_number) # unique worms
  ) %>%
  mutate(avg_neurons_per_worm = n / n_worms) %>%
  arrange(Strain, Dose, Day)

n_per_group_tceoh <- tceoh_data_norm %>%
  group_by(Strain, Dose, Day) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),                          # total neurons measured
    n_worms = n_distinct(image_number) # unique worms
  ) %>%
  mutate(avg_neurons_per_worm = n / n_worms) %>%
  arrange(Strain, Dose, Day)
```

#Running Three Way ANOVAs
``` {r Three-Way ANOVA}
model_tca <- aov(area_percent ~ Day * Dose * Strain, 
               data = tca_data_norm)

summary(model_tca)
#Nothing is significant.

model_tceoh <- aov(area_percent ~ Day * Dose * Strain, 
               data = tceoh_data_norm)

summary(model_tceoh)
#day, day:dose, day:strain, and day:dose:strain are significant.
```

``` {r checking normality and variances - TCA}
#Normality
#Checking the normality of the residuals - data mostly meets the normality assumption but it is curved at the ends
res <- residuals(model_tca)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)
hist(res)

shapiro.test(residuals(model_tca))

res <- residuals(model_tceoh)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)
hist(res)

shapiro.test(residuals(model_tceoh))
```

#Running ANOVAs - TCA
``` {r checking variance of TCA data}
#Equal Variances - there are variations but I can run a robust ANOVA to be safe
ggplot(tca_data_norm_bz555, aes(x = interaction(Dose, Day), y = area_percent)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, fill = "lightblue") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.3) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

tca_data_norm_bz555 %>%
  group_by(Strain, Dose, Day) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_area = mean(area_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    var_area = var(area_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_area = sd(area_percent, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

ggplot(tca_data_norm_ua44, aes(x = interaction(Strain, Dose, Day), y = area_percent)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, fill = "lightblue") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.3) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

tca_data_norm_ua44 %>%
  group_by(Strain, Dose, Day) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_area = mean(area_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    var_area = var(area_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_area = sd(area_percent, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

``` {r two-way ANOVAs - TCA}
#ANOVA for TCA Data Only - Area + BZ555
model_tca_bz555 <- aov(area_percent ~ Day * Dose, 
               data = tca_data_norm_bz555)

summary(model_tca_bz555)
#Nothing is significant

model_tca_ua44 <- aov(area_percent ~ Day * Dose, 
               data = tca_data_norm_ua44)

summary(model_tca_ua44)
#Day and day:dose are significant

#The problem with this ANOVA is that it doesn't average the neurons before running it and I think that it should
```

``` {r checking normality for two-way ANOVAs - TCA}
#Normality
#Checking the normality of the residuals - data mostly meets the normality assumption but it is curved at the ends
res <- residuals(model_tca_bz555)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)
hist(res)

shapiro.test(residuals(model_tca_bz555))

res <- residuals(model_tca_ua44)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)
hist(res)

shapiro.test(residuals(model_tca_ua44))
```

``` {r robust ANOVA method - TCA}
# Two-way robust ANOVA - area
anova_results_tca_bz555 <- aov_ez(
  id = "image_number",        # unique identifier per worm
  dv = "area_percent",
  between = c("Dose", "Day"),
  data = tca_data_norm_bz555,
  type = 3,              # Type III sums of squares
  factorize = FALSE,
  white.adjust = TRUE    # robust to unequal variances
)

anova_results_tca_bz555
#Nothing is significant

anova_results_tca_ua44 <- aov_ez(
  id = "image_number",        # unique identifier per worm
  dv = "area_percent",
  between = c("Dose", "Day"),
  data = tca_data_norm_ua44,
  type = 3,              # Type III sums of squares
  factorize = FALSE,
  white.adjust = TRUE    # robust to unequal variances
)

anova_results_tca_ua44
#Dose and Day are near significance (0.06) but not actually significant
```

``` {r checking normality of robust ANOVA method - TCA}
#Normality
#Checking the normality of the residuals - the residuals actually look more normal using the robust ANOVA but it's deviating at the tails of the data
res <- residuals(anova_results_tca_bz555)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)
hist(res)

shapiro.test(residuals(anova_results_tca_bz555))

res <- residuals(anova_results_tca_ua44)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)
hist(res)

shapiro.test(residuals(anova_results_tca_ua44))
```


``` {r robust ANOVA method - TCEOH}
  data = tceoh_data_norm_bz555,
  type = 3,              # Type III sums of squares
  factorize = FALSE,
  white.adjust = TRUE    # robust to unequal variances
)

anova_results_tceoh_bz555
#Nothing is significant

anova_results_tceoh_ua44 <- aov_ez(
  id = "image_number",        # unique identifier per worm
  dv = "area_percent",
  between = c("Dose", "Day"),
  data = tceoh_data_norm_ua44,
  type = 3,              # Type III sums of squares
  factorize = FALSE,
  white.adjust = TRUE    # robust to unequal variances
)

anova_results_tceoh_ua44
#Nothing is significant
```

``` {r checking normality of robust ANOVA method - TCEOH}
#Normality
#Checking the normality of the residuals - the residuals actually look more normal using the robust ANOVA but it's deviating at the tails of the data
res <- residuals(anova_results_tceoh_bz555)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)
hist(res)

shapiro.test(residuals(anova_results_tceoh_bz555))

res <- residuals(anova_results_tceoh_ua44)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)
hist(res)

shapiro.test(residuals(anova_results_tceoh_ua44))
```

``` {r aggregating to the worm level - TCEOH}
#Here, I will average the neuron areas to the worms first, then run the ANOVA
neuron_means_tceoh_bz555 <- tceoh_data_norm_bz555 %>%
  group_by(image_number, expt_number, Dose, Day) %>%
  summarise(area_percent = mean(area_percent), .groups = "drop")

neuron_means_tceoh_ua44 <- tceoh_data_norm_ua44 %>%
  group_by(image_number, expt_number, Dose, Day) %>%
  summarise(area_percent = mean(area_percent), .groups = "drop")
```

``` {r two-way ANOVAs - TCEOH - worm averages}
#ANOVA for TCEOH Data Only - Area + BZ555
model_tceoh_bz555_neuron_avg <- aov(area_percent ~ Day * Dose, 
               data = neuron_means_tceoh_bz555)

summary(model_tceoh_bz555_neuron_avg)
#Nothing is significant, day:dose is near significance

model_tceoh_ua44_neuron_avg <- aov(area_percent ~ Day * Dose, 
               data = neuron_means_tceoh_ua44)

summary(model_tceoh_ua44_neuron_avg)
#Nothing is significant
```

``` {r checking normality and variances - TCEOH - worm averages}
#Normality
#Checking the normality of the residuals - data mostly meets the normality assumption but it is curved at the ends
res <- residuals(model_tceoh_bz555_neuron_avg)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)
hist(res)

shapiro.test(residuals(model_tceoh_bz555_neuron_avg))

res <- residuals(model_tceoh_ua44_neuron_avg)
qqnorm(res)
qqline(res)
hist(res)

shapiro.test(residuals(model_tceoh_ua44_neuron_avg))

#Equal Variances - there are variations but I can run a robust ANOVA to be safe
ggplot(neuron_means_tceoh_bz555, aes(x = interaction(Dose, Day), y = area_percent)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, fill = "lightblue") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.3) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

neuron_means_tceoh_bz555 %>%
  group_by(Dose, Day) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_area = mean(area_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    var_area = var(area_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_area = sd(area_percent, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

ggplot(neuron_means_tceoh_ua44, aes(x = interaction(Dose, Day), y = area_percent)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, fill = "lightblue") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.3) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

neuron_means_tceoh_ua44 %>%
  group_by(Dose, Day) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_area = mean(area_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    var_area = var(area_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_area = sd(area_percent, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

#Exporting the Data
``` {r wider format for Prism}
tca_bz555_wide <- neuron_means_tca_bz555 %>%
  select(expt_number, Dose, Day, area_percent) %>%
  group_by(Dose, Day) %>%
  mutate(row = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Day,
    values_from = area_percent
  ) %>%
  arrange(Dose, row) %>%
  select(-row)

tca_ua44_wide <- neuron_means_tca_ua44 %>%
  select(expt_number, Dose, Day, area_percent) %>%
  group_by(Dose, Day) %>%
  mutate(row = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Day,
    values_from = area_percent
  ) %>%
  arrange(Dose, row) %>%
  select(-row)

tceoh_bz555_wide <- neuron_means_tceoh_bz555 %>%
  select(expt_number, Dose, Day, area_percent) %>%
  group_by(Dose, Day) %>%
  mutate(row = row_number()) %>%   # needed to align multiple measurements
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Day,
    values_from = area_percent
  ) %>%
  arrange(Dose, row) %>%
  select(-row)

tceoh_ua44_wide <- neuron_means_tceoh_ua44 %>%
  select(expt_number, Dose, Day, area_percent) %>%
  group_by(Dose, Day) %>%
  mutate(row = row_number()) %>%   # needed to align multiple measurements
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Day,
    values_from = area_percent
  ) %>%
  arrange(Dose, row) %>%
  select(-row)
```
